name: Washington County, Ohio (United States)
description: A uniquely shaped flag: navy blue with a red border, charged with a white outline map of the county bearing red and blue stars for the cities and villages, the numerals 1788 in red at the hoist and white stars along the top and bottom for the townships.
history: Washington County is a county located in the southeastern part of Ohio. The flag was adopted in 1988 (designed by WASCO Workshop employees under former commissioner Wayne Schafer for the county's bicentennial in 1988, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: outline map of the county with red and blue stars for the cities and villages
twenty-two stars along the top and bottom for the townships
